rows.claim: The paper separates expressivity, proof certificates, and feature transfer within exact quantum-compilation regime maps.
rows.warrant: cross-model results and explicit model boundaries

rows.claim: The exact cost is the minimum frozen objective over the feasible compiler configurations for an instance.
The reference-exact region contains instances where reference cost equals exact cost.
The intrinsic support number is the smallest tight support ceiling containing an exact optimum for every admitted instance.
A constructive mechanism requires a feasible witness, strict cost reduction, and a named structural edit.
A proof-validity region is the objective-weight set where one normalization proof remains valid.
A mixed feature cell contains both reference-exact and reference-inexact labels.
The irreducible deterministic lookup error on a finite feature representation is the sum of the minority-label count in each cell.
The shared-tag Pauli model has three paired anticommuting blocks, a shared binary tag relation, and a raw structural support objective.
The rank-two dependent-triple model has two blocks, a dependent third frame per block, and a shared two-bit tag.
The six-term model uses a frozen selection, preparation, and width objective over admitted partition and factoring choices.
Weighted Clifford state preparation uses H, S, S-dagger, and controlled-NOT costs 1,1,1,3 and exact shortest-path costs.
Complete stabilizer-state graph sizes are 6, 60, 1,080, and 36,720 for one through four qubits.
rows.warrant: exact state-space enumeration and independent verifier

rows.claim: Every admitted shared-tag Pauli instance has an exact optimum with frame support at most two under the unit raw-support objective.
The shared-tag proof uses a parity-class deletion that preserves partner and tag relations without tag repair for support at least three.
rows.warrant: written parity proof and local obligation record

rows.claim: The shared-tag local exchange inequality covers 18,432 cases with zero violations.
The parity-class corroboration checks 43,688 odd-parity tuples and finds no support-three-through-eight failure.
The shared-tag support-two theorem does not close the smallest named support-two mechanism vocabulary.
rows.warrant: retained split, borrow, off-support, and hybrid counterexamples

rows.claim: Every admitted rank-two dependent-triple instance has an exact support-one optimum under the unit objective.
Support zero is infeasible in the rank-two model, so its intrinsic support number is exactly one.
The rank-two local proof domains contain 2,880 deletion, 6,912 alignment, 576 same-core rigidity, and 9,216 distinct-core tag rows.
A conserved-syndrome proof gives ceiling five for the rank-two model while its intrinsic support number is one.
Rank minus intrinsic support equals the measured exchange margin on two models but fails rewrite-alignment robustness.
The support-one proof applies inside the four stated objective halfspaces.
Outside the objective region the certificate is silent and does not establish support-two necessity.
rows.warrant: explicit outside-region semantics in objective result record

rows.claim: A corrected frozen-domain search finds zero strict support-two witnesses among 211,248 candidates under four objectives.
The six-term reference construction is exact if and only if the proved pair-gain condition holds for every admitted batch and size.
The six-term proof covers 203 partitions and 11 shapes, with complete regressions of 729 and 38,760 instances.
Complete one-, two-, and three-qubit state domains contain 5, 28, and 189 reference-exact states out of 6, 60, and 1,080.
Exact state-preparation improvements include order, pivot, route, and global mechanisms.
The frozen four-qubit forecast matches 100 of 120 regime labels and 67 of 120 exact costs and fails both exactness criteria.
The coarse 13-feature representation has 12 mixed cells and an irreducible 43/1,146 error floor.
The 127-feature sign-aware representation has zero mixed cells and zero irreducible errors on the complete 1,146-state small-size domain.
The rich representation creates 1,109 cells and 1,072 singleton cells for 1,146 states, ratio 0.967714.
Parity-split lookup on the frozen 120-state panel covers two states and makes 32 errors, all among uncovered states.
The shuffle-null mean is 32.41 errors and the empirical probability of errors no larger than observed is 0.51.
Algorithm selection predates this work and is a parent problem.
Instance-space analysis already maps features and algorithm performance.
Quantum optimization and compilation already use algorithm selection and compiler-option prediction.
Verified optimization, exact pattern matching, and ZX simplification are established.
Quantum compiler benchmarks and bounded optimal Clifford synthesis are established.
Pauli-based compilation and simultaneous Pauli-cluster diagonalization are established.
Connectivity overhead is an independent resource coordinate absent from the structural objectives studied here.
rows.warrant: Yuan and Zhang 2025 abstract plus model definitions

rows.claim: The four models are examples that separate logical coordinates, not a statistical sample of compilers.
No universal low-dimensional compiler phase diagram is claimed.
No physical-runtime, hardware-advantage, or production-transfer claim is supported.
rows.warrant: frozen structural objectives and no hardware study

rows.claim: The rich feature result establishes finite-domain vocabulary existence, not compact structure or transfer.
rows.warrant: cell counts and failed panel transfer
